cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Confess Around Them
cards.instruction: Use partial admissions to make a reciprocal confession feel like the only missing piece.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I changed the meeting time. Did you change the room?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Yes. That's my half of why nobody met.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I should have. Now tell me where your half of the meeting went.

mechanism: A supervises a factual reconstruction through partial self-admissions so B's own hidden change becomes the only unfilled explanation.
confusable: D184 extracts B's account before own reveal; D232 gives partial admissions to elicit reciprocity.
comparison: Meeting coordination and omissions differ from concealed correspondence.
seedUse: Keep A's time change and omitted notice but make B's room issue a real unanswered variable rather than assumed equal blame.
